actions.label: 磁盘使用
actions.windowsCommand: Write-Host "┌──────┬────────────┬────────────┬────────────┬─────────┐" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "│ Name │ FreeGB     │ UsedGB     │ TotalGB    │ Used%   │" -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host "├──────┼────────────┼────────────┼────────────┼─────────┤" -ForegroundColor Cyan; 'C','D','H' | % { $d=Get-PSDrive $_; $f=[math]::Round($d.Free/1GB,2); $u=[math]::Round($d.Used/1GB,2); $t=[math]::Round(($d.Free+$d.Used)/1GB,2); $p=[math]::Round(($d.Used/($d.Free+$d.Used))*100,2); Write-Host ("│ {0,-4} │ {1,10} │ {2,10} │ {3,10} │ {4,6}% │" -f $d.Name, "$f GB", "$u GB", "$t GB", $p) -ForegroundColor $(if($p -gt 75){'Red'}elseif($p -gt 60){'Yellow'}else{'Green'}) }; Write-Host "└──────┴────────────┴────────────┴────────────┴─────────┘" -ForegroundColor Cyan

actions.label: 重启程序
actions.windowsCommand: $dataDir = if ($env:TCB_DATA_DIR) { $env:TCB_DATA_DIR } else { Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('UserProfile')) '.tcb\orbit-safe-claw' }; $statePath = Join-Path $dataDir 'web\runtime_state.json'; $port = if (Test-Path $statePath) { (Get-Content $statePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).actual_port } elseif ($env:WEB_PORT) { $env:WEB_PORT } else { '8765' }; Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden powershell -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-Command',"try { Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:$port/api/admin/restart' -TimeoutSec 3 | Out-Null } catch { Write-Error $_ }")
actions.linuxCommand: cd /home/ubuntu/telegram-cli-bot-master && TOKEN=$(awk -F= '$1=="WEB_API_TOKEN"{print $2}' .env | tr -d '"'\'"'"' ') && curl -fsS -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:8765/api/admin/restart" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

actions.label: 内存占用
actions.windowsCommand: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $totalGB = $os.TotalVisibleMemorySize / 1048576; $freeGB = $os.FreePhysicalMemory / 1048576; $usedGB = $totalGB - $freeGB; Write-Host "当前物理内存占用率: $([math]::Round(($usedGB / $totalGB) * 100, 2))%，已用: $([math]::Round($usedGB, 2)) GB，总计: $([math]::Round($totalGB, 2)) GB"
